scope_note: Corrective policy-1.3.0 synthesis. Three legacy combined real-and-personal-property FTZ counterfactuals are superseded by narrower business-personal-property-only estimates because the Apple BPP account directly exhibits the 5% assessment ratio while the real-property account has a different valuation base. The replacements hold observed effective tax rates and full cash value constant and isolate only the assessment-ratio component; they are not cash grants, audited forgone-revenue amounts or net fiscal benefits. All other legacy Apple Mesa estimates fail the direct-evidence, scope, time-profile, geography or decision-relevance gates and are marked for removal in the evidence fragment.

estimates.label: Modeled BPP FTZ assessment-ratio tax reduction versus Class 1

interval.interpretation: Assessment-ratio-only counterfactual holding the BPP account's observed effective tax relation and valuation constant.

parameters.name: business_property_tax_paid
parameters.transformation: Scaled by the Class 1-to-FTZ assessment-ratio difference

parameters.name: class_1_ratio
parameters.transformation: Divided by the observed 5% BPP assessment ratio

provenance.detail: BPP assessed value equals 5% of full cash value

estimates.confidence_rationale: The paid BPP tax and both assessment ratios are directly sourced, but actual counterfactual levies and taxpayer behavior are unobserved.
estimates.decision_relevance: Isolates the business-personal-property assessment-ratio component of FTZ treatment without applying the same scaling to the real-property account.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Official counterfactual BPP bill and taxing-jurisdiction levy simulation without Class 6 treatment

derivation.formula: BPP tax paid × (Class 1 ratio ÷ observed 5% BPP ratio - 1)
assumptions: Class 1 ratio is 17% and the Apple BPP account's observed FTZ ratio is 5%.
Effective tax rates, levies, full cash value and payment behavior remain unchanged.

limitations: No official no-FTZ tax bill is public.
Holds levies and effective tax relations fixed.
Excludes the real-property account and is not a cash grant or net fiscal benefit.
estimates.notes: Corrected BPP-only statutory counterfactual; supersedes the legacy combined-account 2023 estimate.
